versions.subject: feat: first batch update for regsvr32
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\regsvr32.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'REGSVR32.EXE'
selection_flag:
    CommandLine|contains: ' /i'
selection_protocol:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'ftp'
        - 'http'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\regsvr32.exe" OR OriginalFileName="REGSVR32.EXE" CommandLine="* /i*" CommandLine IN ("*ftp*", "*http*")
